Screen-reader and keyboard support across the dashboard, baseline
security headers on every server response, and a fixed desktop
scrollbar. No migration — pull the new image and recreate the container.

## What changed

- **Dashboard is navigable by screen reader and keyboard.** Toasts
  announce politely instead of staying silent, the attention banner
  reports status instead of interrupting, every dialog has an accessible
  name, scrollable regions are keyboard-focusable with labels, all
  settings controls and log filters have programmatic names, and a skip
  link jumps straight to the episode pipeline. Verified with a
  19-check browser sweep (dialogs, focus, overflow, zero console
  errors).
- **Security headers on all responses.** Every dashboard reply —
  including the health probe, API 404s, and static files — now carries
  `nosniff`, framing denial, and a strict referrer policy, covered by a
  new end-to-end test that boots the real request handler.
- **Desktop scrollbar fixed.** Right-edge library tooltips opened upward
  and spilled 83px past the viewport even while hidden, giving the page
  a phantom horizontal scrollbar at desktop widths. They now open to
  the left on desktop with narrower bubbles on mobile.

## Upgrading

Pull the new image and recreate the container. No config changes and
nothing to clean up.
